title: Device state report (iot/{site}/{sourceId}/{deviceId}/state)
description: Retained report of a device's latest attribute set. The registry replaces the previous state wholesale; a report with empty attrs still marks the device seen.

v.description: Payload schema version. Versions live in the payload, never in the topic.

at.description: Event time, Unix milliseconds UTC. Preserved through offline buffering; the registry also records its own arrival time.

category.description: Source-declared device category (e.g. door_sensor). Honored by the registry on first sight only; operators re-categorize via the console.

attrs.description: Latest attribute set of the device. Device-class specific; the console renders unknown attributes as raw JSON.
